propositions: macOS pytest cell is a critical path bottleneck taking ~2140-2486s and runs 3.7x slower per test than Ubuntu due to process-spawn and fixture overhead
the macOS pytest cell currently runs the full default suite plus integration tier unnecessarily, while Linux remains the authoritative full-suite runner

a centralised platform_compat auto-marker in conftest.py selects only Darwin-sensitive tests (file locking, atomic operations, subprocess timeout, cross-process git contention) and replaces the macOS full default-suite run
macOS DEFAULT_SUITE_MARKS in _build-and-test.yml is updated from two-branch to three-branch logic selecting 'platform_compat and not external' while Ubuntu remains 'not integration and not external'
test_ci_workflow_parity.py and a silent-shrink guard validate that platform_compat collects a non-empty representative set of platform-sensitive tests and prevents accidental marker drift
